title: Synthetic working case definition: acute diarrhoeal illness
licence: SYNTHETIC test data - no real licence
abstract: [SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT] A synthetic working case definition for acute diarrhoeal illness, used only to exercise retrieval and filtering. It is not a real case definition.

excerpts.text: A synthetic suspected case of acute diarrhoeal illness is a person with three or more loose stools in 24 hours, reported by a health facility within the surveillance window.
A synthetic cluster is two or more suspected cases that are linked by place and by time.
